items.title: New electricity price takes effect
items.quote: aufgrund gestiegener Netzentgelte und Beschaffungskosten passen wir unsere Preise zum 01.01.2026 an:
items.computation: The letter states the new prices (Arbeitspreis, Grundpreis, monthly Abschlag) apply from a fixed calendar date printed in the letter: 01.01.2026. No period calculation is needed.

items.title: Special right to terminate contract without notice due to price increase
items.quote: Sie haben das Recht, Ihren Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Preisänderung zu kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: Under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG the customer may terminate without notice period effective at the moment the price increase takes effect (01.01.2026). To be effective from that date, the termination (in Textform) must reach the provider before the increase takes effect, i.e. by the last day of the current price period. The letter does not print an explicit calendar deadline for sending the notice, so the last day on which the new (higher) price has not yet applied, 31.12.2025 (the day before 01.01.2026), is used as the practical last date to ensure the special termination is honoured before the new price starts; this is the earliest plausible reading and not an explicit date from the letter.

warnings: The letter itself does not print an explicit calendar deadline for exercising the special termination right (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG); the date given (31.12.2025) is the earliest plausible reading, derived from the price-change effective date, not a date stated in the letter — confirm directly with the provider if timing is critical.
